title: Resolve every interlocking participant and lifeline

facts.note: Requires an observer that recognises plan artifacts and the interlockings (participant and lifeline lists) inside them; the source does not establish that such a file-kind classifier exists today.

values: planner_plan_integrity reports a participant or lifeline that is neither an external actor nor a typed reference to a declared artifact
facts.note: The source names planner_plan_integrity as the implementing validator but does not specify its finding format; a finding signal for this rule must be confirmed or added.
Vendored and generated trees are never scanned (source exception).

fires: Any participant an interlocking lists that is neither an external actor (`user:…`, `system:…`) nor a typed reference to an artifact the plan declares — including untyped/free-text names, whether or not a matching artifact exists.

Any lifeline an interlocking lists that is neither an external actor nor a typed reference to an artifact the plan declares — including untyped lifelines whose intended target exists, and typed references whose target is not declared in the plan.
Existing, unchanged interlockings in a plan that violate the invariant (the rule applies to every listed participant and lifeline, not only edited ones).
doesNotFire: Every participant and lifeline of every interlocking is either an external actor (`user:…`, `system:…`) or a typed reference whose target artifact is declared in the same plan.

given: A plan contains an interlocking that lists participants and lifelines
when: The plan is authored, revised or checked
then: Every participant and lifeline the interlocking lists is either an external actor (`user:…`, `system:…`) or a typed reference to an artifact the plan declares.
prefer: Declare the missing participant as an artifact in the plan and reference it with a typed reference.
Correct a lifeline that points at the wrong, an undeclared, or an untyped target.
avoid: Routing decisions between participants the plan does not declare.
Free-text or untyped participant/lifeline names, even when a matching artifact exists.
why: A routing decision between participants the plan does not declare cannot be traced to anything that implements it.
evidence: planner_plan_integrity validator passes for the plan with respect to interlocking participants and lifelines.
Each participant/lifeline either carries a `user:`/`system:` prefix or is a typed reference whose target is declared in the same plan.
verifier_detail: Implementation: validator planner_plan_integrity. Check every participant and lifeline in each interlocking (not only changed ones): accept `user:…` and `system:…` external actors; otherwise require a typed reference resolving to an artifact the plan declares.
Never scan vendored and generated trees: `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`.

Package rule, strict: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node; held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.
